operations.name: search_flights
operations.description: Search Cathay Pacific for available one-way flights on a given route and date. Returns flights with departure times, durations, and a 7-day fare calendar.

args.name: origin
args.description: Departure IATA airport code (e.g. HKG, LHR, JFK)

args.name: destination
args.description: Arrival IATA airport code (e.g. LHR, HKG, SYD)

args.name: cabin_class
args.description: Cabin class: ECONOMY, PREMIUM ECONOMY, BUSINESS, or FIRST
